title: Khamoshiyan
desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, travels to Kashmir for inspiration and starts staying at a mysterious guest house. He falls in love with Meera, the owner of the guesthouse, who harbours a dark secret.

title: Karthik Calling Karthik
desc: A shy man starts receiving mysterious calls from himself, unraveling a gripping psychological twist tied to trauma, self-worth, and hidden fears.

title: Chandu Champion
desc: With unyielding spirit, a man overcomes relentless challenges, forging a path to groundbreaking achievement.

title: Bawaal
desc: A man wants to marry with the most beautiful girl in town one day because marrying her can raise his social position.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: Shalini, once a naive nursing student from Kerala, recounts her tragic journey as she becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifying how innocence led her into the shadows of extremism.

title: Tarla
desc: Explores Tarla Dalal's journey and legacy as an iconoclast during the early liberalisation period, empowering women through the art of cooking.

title: Turtle
desc: In a drought-struck village in Rajasthan, Ramkaran Choudhary churns the parched earth to extract water while the villagers indulge in a tug of war in desperation as they seek to quench their thirst.

title: Sonchiriya
desc: After their leader's death, a notorious dacoit gang splits into factions. In their journey forward, they cross paths with Indumati and Khushi, sparking unexpected turns and emotional revelations.

title: Dhokha (2007)
desc: Police Inspector Zaid is shocked when he learns that Sara, his late wife, is suspected to be a suicide bomber. However, he sets out to learn Sara's side of the story and gets justice for her.
